audit.title: Comprehensive Security Audit - Final Overhaul Verification

controls.name: Zod Schema Validation
controls.description: All request bodies validated with strict Zod schemas

controls.name: SQL Injection Detection
controls.description: Pattern-based detection for SQL keywords and syntax

controls.name: API Key Whitelist
controls.description: Strict character whitelist: ^[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{12,256}$

controls.name: Content-Type Parsing
controls.description: Proper MIME-type parsing with split(';') to handle charset

controls.name: HTML Entity Escaping
controls.description: Two-step: remove control chars, then escape HTML entities

controls.name: Input Length Limits
controls.description: STRING_MAX_LENGTH=10000, BODY=1MB, QUERY=10KB, HEADER=8KB

controls.name: URL Protocol Whitelist
controls.description: Only http: and https: allowed, blocks javascript: and data:

controls.name: Security Headers
controls.description: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY

controls.name: Content-Type Validation
controls.description: Exact match required: application/json only

controls.name: Bearer Token Requirement
controls.description: Authorization header with Bearer token required

controls.name: CORS Origin Allowlist
controls.description: Type-safe allowlist: localhost, omni360, app.omnichannelsol.com

controls.name: Preflight Handling
controls.description: OPTIONS requests return 204 No Content, Max-Age=86400

controls.name: Session Cookie Validation
controls.description: JWT format only, rejects bare UUIDs, verifies signature

controls.name: JWT Token Validation
controls.description: Validates sub, email, role, iat, exp with type checking

controls.name: Password Strength
controls.description: Min 8 chars, uppercase, lowercase, digit, special char, no 3+ consecutive

controls.name: Timing-Safe Comparison
controls.description: timingSafeEqual() for email and password prevents enumeration

controls.name: Role-Based Access Control
controls.description: ROLE_PERMISSIONS matrix with admin/user/viewer roles

controls.name: Generic Error Messages
controls.description: Returns generic 'Invalid email or password', no field hints

controls.name: No Sensitive Logging
controls.description: Logs email only, never logs token or password

controls.name: Cache Control
controls.description: no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, proxy-revalidate

controls.name: Log Injection Prevention
controls.description: API key validation blocks control chars, newlines, tabs

controls.name: JWT Signature Algorithm
controls.description: HS256 algorithm with secret from JWT_SECRET env var

controls.name: Secret Management
controls.description: JWT_SECRET required in production, throws error if missing

controls.name: Token Expiration
controls.description: Access token 24h, refresh token 7d, validated on every request

controls.name: Secure Randomness
controls.description: Uses Node.js crypto module for token generation, no Math.random()

controls.name: Per-User Rate Limiting
controls.description: Extract userId from Bearer token with JWT verification

controls.name: Per-IP Rate Limiting
controls.description: getClientIp() extracts from X-Forwarded-For, CF-Connecting-IP, or socket

controls.name: Per-API-Key Rate Limiting
controls.description: Extract from Authorization or X-API-Key header with format validation

controls.name: Rate Limit Headers
controls.description: X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset, Retry-After

controls.name: No UUID Session Forgery
controls.description: JWT format check + signature verification, rejects bare UUIDs

improvements_audit_89_to_93.benefit: Properly handles charset parameter, prevents MIME-type confusion attacks
Word boundary regex prevents false positives, single toLowerCase call improves performance

attack_scenarios_tested.attack: Send crafted UUID as session cookie
attack_scenarios_tested.defense: JWT format validation + signature verification, rejects bare UUIDs
Exact MIME-type match after parsing charset

attack_scenarios_tested.attack: Time login response to determine if email exists
Send message with SQL syntax: '; DROP TABLE agents; --
attack_scenarios_tested.defense: Zod validation + word boundary regex matching

attack_scenarios_tested.attack: Send message with XSS payload:
attack_scenarios_tested.defense: Zod validation + JSON response (not HTML) + security headers
CORS allowlist + Content-Type validation + bearer token requirement

priority_2_optional: Security audit logging with tamper detection
priority_3_operational: Document rate limit presets and tuning
